title_template: {work_unit_id} — Explicit Owner Authorization for reusable autonomous continuation executor
goal: Require one exact explicit Owner Authorization, bound to the canonical WU-110 preparation contract blob and WU-110 post-merge main SHA, before any reusable autonomous continuation executor grant can become canonical.
scope: fresh-read canonical WU-110 preparation after its merge and bind authorization to its exact contract blob and actual post-merge main SHA
accept only an explicit Owner Authorization whose scope is exactly REUSABLE_AUTONOMOUS_CONTINUATION_EXECUTOR_ONLY; generic continuation text such as Continue or Продолжай is insufficient
materialize one machine-readable Owner Authorization receipt only after exact explicit authorization is present
prepare one canonical reusable autonomous continuation executor grant bound to the exact receipt, WU-110 preparation contract and immutable WU-109 admission plus existing reusable authority anchors
keep the future executor limited to delegating only transaction paths independently admitted by WU-109 and still authorized by their existing reusable grants
define revocation, anchor-drift, stale provider truth, interruption, wait, stop, blocked and classified-failure behavior as fail closed
perform no reusable autonomous continuation executor transaction during this authorization Work Unit
forbidden_scope: treat generic Continue, Продолжай, keep going or equivalent continuation language as Owner Authorization
create an Owner Authorization receipt or reusable executor grant without exact explicit Owner Authorization
execute Issue-create, Issue-update, branch, pull-request, provider-state, Writer Lease, workflow-rerun, merge or Issue-close through the reusable executor during the authorization Work Unit
broaden or replace the existing materialization, Writer Lease or merge/Issue-close grants
mutate product/runtime source or runtime state
mutate ADWF Consumer binding/provenance or the ADWF repository
perform release/tag/promotion, ruleset/policy administration, PRIVATE evidence publication or 1080/1081 lifecycle mutation
exit_criteria: explicit Owner Authorization is present and its exact scope is REUSABLE_AUTONOMOUS_CONTINUATION_EXECUTOR_ONLY
authorization receipt binds the exact canonical WU-110 preparation contract blob and actual WU-110 post-merge main SHA
canonical reusable executor grant binds the exact receipt, preparation contract, WU-109 admission anchors and unchanged existing reusable authority grants
the grant cannot infer authority and cannot execute wait, stop, blocked or separate-authority states
all stale, contradictory, interrupted, classified-failure, revoked or anchor-drift states fail closed
exact-head hosted CI passes with no executor transaction, product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
